bbox_forge_space_m.note: Blender is Z-up; Forge is Y-up. Extents: width 0.6, depth 0.265625, height 1.74375.

honesty: the phantom is synthetic and self-authored; it is a method harness, not a character
no owner-private reference image or model was used
no neural model, external API, or GPU was involved
the hull is a visual hull: it bounds, it does not invent, unseen concavities are not measured
the hull was imported into the live Blender 5.2.2 scene into an isolated collection, measured, and removed; the scene was not saved and object count was restored to 1143

interpretation.accuracy_ceiling: 0.87 hull-vs-solid IoU is inherent to the 4-orthogonal-view visual hull, not a voxel-resolution problem: it plateaus between 0.847 and 0.878 across grids 48..96 while triangles grow from 14664 to 57088.
interpretation.dominant_ambiguity: Arm columns are carved with torso-depth z-extent because the front/back views cannot separate arm depth from torso depth. Predicted overfill ~0.016 m^3 vs measured 0.0139 m^3 at grid 64.

limitations: orthographic silhouettes only; perspective references need rectification
concave detail no view can see is bounded by the hull, not measured
a silhouette set constrains shape; it does not prove identity or likeness
masks must be pre-segmented by the owner/segmentation stage

reproduction.score: python -m forge.cli reconstruct-score --spec examples/multiview-phantom/spec.json --truth examples/multiview-phantom/truth.json --out build/multiview-accuracy.json
